(OT) or a placebo (PL).

You must use data in your answer.

text: In the study by Milgram (obedience), a shock generator was used. It consisted of 30 lever switches
in a horizontal line.
Describe the shock generator used in this study, other than these features.
Your friend, Alfonso, is finding it difficult to concentrate at school. He tells you that his concentration
is worse when he is bored. He has come to you for advice about ways to help him improve his
concentration.
Outline the advice you would give to Alfonso, using your knowledge of the study by Andrade
(doodling).
